source_reference.paper_title: Low functional diversity promotes niche changes in natural island pollinator communities
source_reference.target_source_locator: electronic supplementary material Table S2; Table S4 for the five taxa with explicitly reported site-specific numeric values
source_reference.paper_measurement_protocol: At each site, five pollinator individuals per species, or all individuals when fewer than five were available, were measured with digital calipers; mean proboscis length was calculated per species x site.

current_trait_coverage.safe_join_rule: exact taxon name or whitespace-only normalization

admission_rules: Join historical source traits by exact taxon name plus site whenever site-specific source values are available.
Table S2 species-level numeric values may be transferred across sites only under a prospectively frozen estimand-specific rule; they are not silently relabelled as site-exact values.
The signed-position community-center rule was frozen before its target fit in commit 646f5236fca6144ce73a69ac3fe81b2d825afe17.
Functional-group bins (<4.5, 4.5-9, >9 mm) are descriptive classes and are not numeric substitutes for Rao-Q distances.
Do not impute proboscis length from taxonomic family, body size, guild label, or external allometry in the primary Izu-compatible analyses.
Future field visitors with no exact source trait remain trait_missing until measured directly or supported by a prospectively frozen transfer rule.
Trait values and any transfer rule must be frozen independently of SVD, dependency, fruit, seed, or floral-response outcomes.
